title_es_or_en: Dar' ta'arud al-'aql wa-l-naql (Averting the Conflict between Reason and Revelation)
edition_note: Header: Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyya, Beirut 1417 AH (ed. Abd al-Latif Abd al-Rahman); page refs are the OpenITI PageV markers (vol.page), 10-vol. print edition as reflected in the header. Printed page numbers not checked against a page image.
notes: Ibn Taymiyya's own work. Contains long reports of kalam and philosophical positions which he then critiques; passages used are marked by stance. No editorial headings in the spans used.

title_es_or_en: Al-Istighatha fi al-Radd ala al-Bakri (Refutation of al-Bakri on seeking help from the dead)
edition_note: Header: Dar al-Minhaj, Riyadh, 1st ed. 1426 AH, study and ed. Abd Allah ibn Dujayn al-Sahli; header says numbering matches the print edition. Page refs = OpenITI PageV markers (single volume).
notes: Editor's study and numbered summary points (e.g. '11 - القبورية...') are editorial and NOT Ibn Taymiyya's words. The digital text has inline editorial markers ('|| CHECK', '|| AUTO') and footnote markers (¬n); the span used avoids them. Span used is his own text.

edition_note: Header: Majma al-Malik Fahd, Medina 1416/1995, ed. Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad ibn Qasim. Page refs = OpenITI PageV markers (vol.page); volume/page should be checked against the printed 37-vol. set.
notes: Mostly Ibn Taymiyya's own answers. Some passages reproduce Quran/hadith/tafsir narrations (Ibn Abbas, Ikrima, Ata, Mujahid) inside his argument.
